source: City of Vancouver Open Data: 'Elevation contour lines - 1-metre contours' (elevation-contour-lines-1-metre-contours) and 'Shoreline 2002' (shoreline-2002), the context extent. The heightfield interpolates linearly between the two nearest contour levels at each cell; the land mask is the shoreline flood-filled from known land, and water cells sit below sea level. Retrieved 2026-09-30.
